styleGuide.title: 16-bit crypto fantasy dungeon art pack
styleGuide.sharedPromptPrefix: 16-bit pixel art, crisp readable silhouette, orthographic RPG dungeon crawler, transparent background where appropriate, no text, no watermark, limited palette, chunky pixels, strong rim light, export as PNG, consistent Crypto Moonboys fantasy style
styleGuide.negativePrompt: photorealistic, 3D render, smooth gradients, blurry, anti-aliased edges, modern UI text, watermark, logo text, signature, excessive detail, cropped subject

assets.name: Forest ruins tileset
assets.prompt: A 32x32 tile RPG tileset sheet for HODL or FOLD forest ruins: mossy green stone floor, dark vine-covered walls, cracked market-floor flagstones, paper-hand goblin camp details, red encounter danger tile, gold boss border tile, green entry glyph, cyan exit portal, ruined columns, hedge roots, tiny candles, treasure pile. Arrange as clean grid tiles with transparent margins where needed.
